behavioral_effects: Every SessionStart orientation now routes non-trivial work to pick-workflow and gov-change by name - previously the skills were never mentioned and the router only fired if the model guessed it

debt-sweep, refactor-governed, and pick-workflow now instruct: run the scoped governance-context query BEFORE spawning Explore, and give subagents component roots - the gate denies repo-root sweeps and gates subagents too
compatibility_impact: None - the orientation gained one line; rendered length is 5010 of the 8000-char budget, so nothing truncates
limitations: The pointer is steering, not enforcement; a session that ignores it still hits the Stop hook backstop
reason: The SessionStart orientation names the make targets but never the skills that sequence them, and debt-sweep, refactor-governed, and pick-workflow spawn Explore subagents into a read gate that denies broad sweeps until a scoped governance query has unlocked it - agents discover this by being denied
rollback: git revert of the single commit
security_impact: None - orientation text and skill guidance only
summary: Route sessions to pick-workflow and teach Explore-delegating skills the read gate

validators_run.evidence_ref: 153 tests including the new orientation-pointer assertion against rendered output
